description: This file defines the LeadFeed class, which extends FeedLogicBase and handles the creation of activity feed entries for lead-related events in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. The class includes a method pushFeed that generates feed messages when a lead is created or converted, utilizing locale information and interacting with the SugarFeed class to publish the feed.

classes.name: LeadFeed
classes.description: A class responsible for managing feed updates related to Lead records, specifically creation and conversion events, in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates a feed entry when a lead is created or its status changes to 'Converted', formatted with locale-specific names, and pushes it via SugarFeed.
